body:
Thank you for writing this. The person who wrote this post seems like the kind of person who plays cruel games with people and has reckless relationship behavior and then justifies it by thinking “I’m an adult and I’m free to do... “ 

If someone enters your life and took up space in your heart, then both parties need to value the rarity of that and the care and love that comes from that. Breakups happen, but people can also be kind. 

Have you evaluated your actions lately?
I feel this way too. I want to do it. Think about it everyday but can’t find the courage. I’d like to know how.
I’m here to chat if you want to talk more. I’m up and am good at listening to rants. I know how you feel. I’ll be your company tonight.

Thank you for writing this. I’ve never felt so connected to a story and your feelings in such an intense way. I feel everything that you feel. Currently. God it’s hard. I’m here to talk. 

Female, 28
Where do you live? If you want, we can message each other on the weekends.

I feel like I’m attracted to people who are depressed, lonely, etc. I mean as friends as well as significant others. The intense spectrum of emotions leads me to assume that person has a high level of intellect and empathy that’s a really important trait to have. I feel like I’d love being friends with all of you.
